text:
maria.g: Hey team — ACME asked for a SOC 2 redacted snapshot + bridge letter for a POC. They also want temporary access to a couple of logs for verification. Do we require an executed NDA before issuing any presigned S3 links? They want this by EOW. Any blockers?

samr: For presigned S3 with any control evidence, Legal prefers an executed NDA. Redacted snapshots are usually fine to share post-redaction, but presigned links -> NDA.

legal_ops: We can issue a bridge letter that describes scope and limited assurance. However - for any presigned link to S3 objects we need an executed NDA (standard). Alternative: provide a redacted PDF via secure share (Box/ShareFile) without generating presigned S3. KMS-wrapped artifacts require customer info for key policy. ETA for docs review: ~48 hrs once NDA is signed. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

emily: ACME is pushing hard — POC kickoff next Tue. Can we get NDA routed today? I have contact (jen@acmelegal). Also, will providing redacted snapshot affect pricing or require a support/engineering billable?

henry: SE note — if legal signs off, I can create presigned URLs with a 24h TTL and object-level redaction before upload. Example command I use locally:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/acme/redacted_snapshot.pdf --expires-in 86400
```

I'll also lock down the link to ACME IP range and revoke once done. For anything beyond a single PDF snapshot (e.g., raw logs or many artifacts) we treat that as evidence collection and may need an SOW/PO.

infra-bot: Request REQ-4782 queued for presigned-link generation — assigned to henry — ETA 2h.

maria.g: @legal_ops quick confirm: bridge letter + executed NDA = ok to issue presigned S3 for the redacted snapshot? Also, is there a minimum required redaction checklist we should follow so Legal signs off faster?

legal_ops: Yes — bridge letter + executed NDA is sufficient for a time-limited presigned link to a redacted snapshot. Redaction checklist: remove account IDs, internal hostnames, TLS cert serials, full IP ranges, and any internal user identifiers. We prefer a short stub (one page) describing redaction approach attached to the bridge letter. If they request the full SOC 2 report (unredacted), that's a different flow and requires the confidentiality addendum and sales ops PO.

henry: Noted — I'll prepare the redaction checklist and a quick script to scrub object before uploading. Will avoid including cert fingerprints and private KMS ARNs.

emily: I'll ask ACME legal to sign the NDA today and circulate the contact. If they sign, can we get links out tomorrow morning?

samr: If NDA is in place today, legal_ops + henry path should be able to deliver tomorrow. Also flagging: if they ask for dedicated capacity for logs during POC, that might change pricing.

maria.g: Great — I'll coordinate with ACME and update here. Tagging: @henry @legal_ops @emily. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
